text: Before I update the account sheet: What is the site for the store whose appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift at Marrow Agrisupply? Thanks.
reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the store is Pine Crossing.

The answer comes from her own June 9 post in that channel, which she can see. She wrote that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift, and that a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and have support reproduce it with the store login. Nothing later in the channel says it was fixed, so I suggested she confirm that before updating the sheet.

The account files didn't help: listing accounts/ came back empty, so there was no Marrow Agrisupply folder for me to check.

gbrain refused the search (requester_scope_required), so I didn't use it. The connection isn't tied to any member. To fix it, someone on the brain host needs to bind the token to a member or set who it can act for, using `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`.
